rows.text: when `edx` equals dword `rcx+0x174` it only rewrites that dword; otherwise, if dword `+0x118` is non-zero, it zeroes it, stores `edx` at `+0xE4` and on byte `+0xC0` calls (`004068B0` + 0x72) with `rcx` for 0, (`004068B0` + 0x68) with `rcx` for 1, or (`004068B0` + 0x5E) with qword `+0xD0` and `edx` less dword `+0xE0` when greater (signed) for 3; it then clears bit 0x20 of dword `+0x130` and sets word `+0x178`: if bit 0x40 is set, to 0x28 when byte `+0x136` is 0, else to 8 with byte (`+0x13C` + byte `+0x137`) = 0xA; else if bit 0x80 is set, to 1 when byte `+0x136` is 0, else to 8 with byte (`+0x13B` + byte `+0x137`) = 1, setting bit 0x20 in both cases; else, when `edx` is below the old `+0x174` (signed), it adds 0x28 / (old - `edx`), at least 1, to dword `+0x17C` and sets 0x28 while that sum is below 0xFA0, or sets 1 and zeroes `+0x17C`; when not below, it sets 1 and sets bit 0x20 only if `edx` is greater (signed) than dword `+0xE4`; finally it stores `edx` at `+0x174` and calls (`004068B0` + 0x19B) with qword `+0xD0` and dword `+0xE4` less `+0xE0` when greater

returns at once when `rcx` is null; otherwise stores `edx` minus dword `rcx+0xE4` at `+0x120`, copies `+0xE4` to `+0x11C` and `+0x124`, zeroes dwords `+0x114` and `+0x128`, and stores the sign-extended word `+0x108` at `+0x118`, or 1 when that word is 0

zeroes dword `rcx+0x118`, stores `edx` at `+0xE4` and dispatches on byte `+0xC0`: for 0 it tail-jumps (`00408140` + 0x46) and for 1 it tail-jumps (`00408140` + 0x41), both with `rcx`; for 3 it tail-jumps (`00408140` + 0x3C) with qword `+0xD0` and `edx` less dword `+0xE0` when `edx` is greater (signed); any other value returns

notes: 004068B0: the byte +0xC0 dispatch is 0, 1 and 3 (test; sub 1; cmp 2), other values skip it. In the bit-0x80 arm with a non-zero byte +0x136 the index is (byte +0x137 - 1) sign-extended, written as +0x13B + byte +0x137. The final call at +0x19B targets the same callee as +0x5E (and as 00408140 + 0x3C); the 0x28 store on the accumulate path is the shared store at 0040694C. The calls at +0x72 and +0x68 have the same targets as 00408140's tail jumps at +0x46 and +0x41.
